figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 2.
Gene Expression Analysis of the cpa Cluster in A. oryzae.
Northern blot analysis of cpaA, cpaD, cpaO, and cpaH in the cpa
cluster in A. oryzae RIB 40, NBRC 4177, and cpaR, a gene
disruption strain of cpaR in A. oryzae NBRC 4177. Total RNAs
were isolated from mycelia cultivated for 48 h at 30 C in CYA
liquid medium. Ten mg of total RNAs were loaded, and the quantity
of the RNAs was evaluated by rRNAs stained with ethidium
bromide.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 1.
Cyclopiazonic Acid Biosynthesis Gene Cluster in A. oryzae.
A, Schematic representation of the cyclopiazonic acid biosynthesis gene cluster (cpa cluster) in A. oryzae RIB 40 and NBRC 4177. The cpa
cluster in strain RIB 40 is truncated by telomere within the coding region of cpaA. B, Structures of the intermediates in the biosynthetic pathway
of 2-oxocyclopiazonic acid (2-oxoCPA) in A. oryzae. Genes in the cpa cluster corresponding to each pathway are described beside arrows.
Abbreviations: cAATrp, cyclo-acetoacetyl-L-tryptophan; -CPA, -cyclopiazonic acid; CPA, cyclopiazonic acid; 2-oxoCPA, 2-oxocyclopia-
zonic acid; DMAPP, dimethylallyl diphosphate

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 3.
Conversion Activity from cAATrp to 2-oxoCPA in A. oryzae
RIB 40.
A, UV absorbance (280 nm) of the extracts from incubated culture
supernatant of NBRC 4177 cpaD containing cAATrp, used as
substrate solution. The UV absorbance of the extracts from the
cultures of A. oryzae RIB 40 (B) and NBRC 4177 cpaA (C) fed
and not fed substrate solution are shown. For the non-fed culture,
sterilized water was used instead of substrate solution. Peaks were
identiﬁed by MS analysis (data not shown).
